title: Review: convergence check after pass 10
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — Three findings after pass 10: one stale doc comment (P1, callers using wrong variant), two misclassified error variants in decrypt.rs and cert.rs (P2). No P0 correctness bugs found. Core logic in cert.rs (issuer_der precomputation, pathLen semantics, cycle detection), encrypt.rs (encrypt_aes_cbc CEK memory safety, closure correctness), verify.rs (match-with-guards), and error.rs (RngFailure/NoRecipients coverage) all check out. No panics in reachable non-test code that cannot be justified by invariants. No timing attacks or key material leaks identified.
Confidence: 92% chance of no missed P0/P1 bug. The remaining 8% covers: (a) interop edge cases in the sign/verify round-trip for the rsaEncryption-as-sigAlg path (no test coverage visible); (b) possible misparse of EccCmsSharedInfo with a non-null entityUInfo field from a third-party sender (encrypt always sets None, but decrypt/verify could receive it); (c) PKCS#7 unpadding errors on tampered or cross-algorithm-decrypted ciphertext returning Other rather than a dedicated TamperedCiphertext variant.
